keyFindings.text: Vega-Lite auto-produces axes/legends/scales from mark+encoding; corpus freezes chrome per form — ahead on determinism, behind on expressiveness
ECharts dataset component is the closest analogue to the corpus data block; corpus is stricter (literal, no runtime reads)
Chart.js ships tooltips+animation+responsive by default; corpus ships none — interaction is the largest behind-surface, cheapest to close with SVG title/pointer handlers
Plotly tick machinery (dtick/nticks/tickformat/d3-format) is richer than corpus niceStep ladder; corpus ladder is fine-grained and sound but duplicated in 9 templates
ECharts places legends upper-right/bottom with scroll for many; corpus uses fixed top-left swatch row with width-estimate math (label.length*6.6) — overlap fragility
Corpus fixed-viewBox scaling is ahead for the static delivery mode; gap is lack of legibility verification at narrow widths, not the mechanism
Corpus niceStep ladder is a sound finer instance of D3 tick doctrine; missing half is auto-precision tickFormat and float accumulation in candlestick tick loop
Plot mark-shape doctrine (rect/barX/barY/cell) formalises the corpus data-shape column; corpus adds orientation guardrail Plot lacks
d3-format s-type SI prefixes are the upstream answer for big-number labels; corpus String(value) has no separator/prefix story, demo data pre-scaled tacitly
Plot line breaks at invalid values; corpus line/range builders emit NaN paths silently — no null handling anywhere
D3 two-sided nice would break corpus zero-baseline discipline; corpus already range-nices exactly the one form (candlestick) where it is honest
No upstream legend placement consensus (top/right/top-right), but all reserve space outside the plot; corpus in-figure swatch row consumes plot budget
Corpus width-estimate positioning (label.length*6.6/6.8/34) is the weakest label technique; upstream measures text, never character-count estimates
Direct labelling is an upstream doctrine and the corpus is already ahead (value labels on bars/segments/cells, anchor flips at edges)
parallel-axes alternating-lift label scheme is bespoke collision avoidance; needs a width check for longer units
Vega-Lite legends carry aria/description; corpus swatch legends' mapping lives only in the data table, not the figure desc
Corpus ramp gates (darkest 3:1, lightest 1.15:1, step 1.3:1, monotonic) are ahead of every surveyed library — no upstream enforces contrast on schemes
Corpus single-hue teal ramp matches CVD guidance; multi-hue ramps carry a Vega cluster-illusion warning; diverging ramp deliberately absent (no consuming form)
Okabe-Ito is the canonical CVD-safe qualitative palette; corpus categorical hues achieve safety by gates+luminance but never name a reference palette in docs
The emphasis role (--chart-emphasis) has no counterpart in any surveyed library; corpus is ahead by design
Upstream draws gradient ramp legends for quantitative scales; corpus textual less/more legend is accessible but an SVG linearGradient swatch is dependency-free
Rule-10 trio ahead of Chart.js (canvas content not accessible to screen readers, per Chart.js docs); granularity validated by Vega's ARIA-bloat concern
Vega per-guide aria/description model: corpus figure desc should enumerate series mapping (one line per template)
ECharts decal patterns are dependency-free via SVG pattern fills; candidate for stacked-bars/stacked-area/unit-ring, per-form decision
ECharts generates aria descriptions from data; corpus hand-written desc goes stale on data edits — data-derived desc clause is deterministic and applyable now
Corpus gates map exactly onto WCAG 2.1 AA 1.4.3 (4.5:1) and 1.4.11 (3:1); un-gated rule role defensible under 1.4.11 scope
Every upstream responsive mechanism (Chart.js resize, Vega-Lite container+autosize, Plot ResizeObserver re-render) needs a runtime; corpus viewBox scaling is the static subset
Min-size guard (svg min-width + figure overflow-x) is the dependency-free responsive improvement; pure CSS, passes all 13 checks
Plot admits margins are not auto-adjusted for long labels; corpus fixed gutters need an explicit per-form label-length budget
Vega-Lite step sizing exists because it lacks capacity discipline; corpus ceilings make it unnecessary — corpus ahead
Narrow-viewport render assertion (--window-size phone viewport) is the contract-level verification candidate
Zero-transform contract is the deliberate inverse of Vega-Lite/Plot transform machinery; catalog data-shape column is the corpus's transform language
Missing data: Plot breaks lines at null, Vega-Lite filters with valid predicate; corpus draws NaN paths silently — null-filter fix is applyable now
Waterfall end + stacked-area total are the corpus's auditable computed-value exceptions; Plot stack transform solves the same problem opaquely
Plot bin insets and corpus surface-stroke separators are equivalent answers to touching marks; corpus mechanism already documented
No shape enforcement exists anywhere upstream; corpus ceilings are documented only — console.warn guard is the minimal bridge
Per-template fmt helper (thousands separators + float-dust trim, locale-fixed) is the applyable-now answer to String(value) everywhere
Candlestick tick loop accumulates float dust (value += step); d3 computes ticks from integer index — floor + step*t is the two-line fix
Corpus time labels are display-ready literals by design; catalog should state the rule so ISO-date readers know conversion is theirs
Corpus hand-rolls Vega-Lite labelOverlap parity thinning (day%7, i%4, [1,3,5]) with undocumented constants — comment the rule per form
Vega-Lite labelAngle -45/labelMaxLength 25 are runtime luxuries; corpus non-rotation stance is deliberate and upstream-informed
Hover tooltips are the default upstream interaction; per-mark SVG title is the dependency-free fix (native tooltip since 2015, trips none of the 13 checks)
SVG title doubles as accessible name per W3C; data table remains the keyboard path (focus-tooltip browser-inconsistent, Chromium bug 829352)
Forms needing titles most are where direct labelling is weakest: scatter, heat-matrix, calendar-grid, candlestick, box-plot, treemap, waterfall, parallel-axes
Title caveats: painted-pixels hover target and no touch tooltips — both covered by visible labels + rule-10 table
JS floating tooltip possible (~30 lines, deterministic) but per-form decision only; native title + labels + table already cover value reading
Ranked template-level list T1-T10 (titles, fmt helper, null-filter, real text measurement, desc fixes, min-size guard, budget comments, gradient legend, shape guard, optional decals)
Ranked contract-level list C1-C5 (narrow-viewport assertion, display-ready label wording, computed-value exception wording, visible shape notice, deferred diverging system)
Palette-level: CVD rationale note + optional Okabe-Ito alignment; gates recompute automatically from palettes.json
Eleven corpus-ahead results identified (ramp gates, emphasis, WCAG mapping, data table, direct labelling, zero baseline, ceilings, parity thinning, computed values, zero transforms, static viewBox)
Coverage check passed: 9/9 questions answered with 15+ distinct sources; ready for synthesis
